_readme: Cross-language conformance fixture for the title of an Amp subagent call.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the worker titles the call's row in the background-task registry
titles the call's card in the transcript (the Amp plugin's ampAgentRequest). The two
surfaces show one call, so they must show one title. Both suites read this file, so an
edit of one side alone turns that side's tests red.
THE RULE. A Task call takes its trimmed description, else the first non-blank line of its
prompt, else the word Subagent. The three specialists take their name, then a colon and
the first non-blank line of their request: the task of an oracle, and the query of a
librarian or a finder. A specialist with no request takes its name alone. A line is
blank when it holds only white space. The cases use spaces, tabs and carriage returns,
which the trim of each language treats alike.

cases.title: First line
cases.why: a blank description gives way to the first non-blank line of the prompt

cases.title: First line
cases.why: a CRLF prompt reads the same

cases.title: Subagent
cases.why: a Task with nothing to show is a subagent

Review the lock order
